content.text:
Perform the final post-UI-polish verification for Entire Echo.

UI checkpoint:
- Commit: d29575706a75e0cfff984f01ec55843043386ba1
- Checkpoint: 01M1TWEGCRSVJ9HZCD7RH7CD84

Previous submitted baseline:
- Commit: 79518ac9349b6cf1e104b1a9c534c2d07a69f6fe

The completed Entire Graph semantic diff is stored at:

/tmp/entire-echo-ui-semantic-diff.json

Do not assume Graph findings are correct. Read the full JSON and verify every
material finding against source, tests and runtime behavior.

Tasks:

1. Summarize the semantic diff:
   - changed files
   - added functions
   - removed functions
   - signature changes
   - body changes
   - dependency counts
   - warnings, partial failures or completeness limitations

2. Carefully verify Graph’s high-dependency findings:
   - `$`
   - `button`
   - `validateBundle`
   - `element` removal
   - `el` addition
   - renderBundle
   - renderCards
   - renderContext
   - updateActiveCard
   - updateSpeechControls
   - speak
   - localVoices

3. Determine whether the reported signature changes are:
   - real behavior/contract changes;
   - internal parameter renames;
   - formatting/parser noise; or
   - potentially unsafe.

4. Verify that:
   - every renamed helper has all callers updated;
   - no stale call to element remains;
   - window.EchoUI keeps the test-facing functions required by existing tests;
   - ReviewBundle validation behavior is unchanged;
   - active-card navigation works;
   - speech still uses only localService === true;
   - selecting another card never starts speech automatically;
   - evidence disclosure keeps exact evidence linkage;
   - incomplete context remains clearly non-authoritative;
   - no external request or asset was introduced.

5. Inspect app.js maintainability.

   If the UI rewrite unnecessarily minified the source, collapsed large
   functions into unreadable lines, or shortened names only to reduce size,
   restore readable formatting and descriptive internal names while preserving
   the polished UI.

   Do not make cosmetic refactors unless they materially improve judge
   readability or eliminate misleading Graph signature changes.

6. Run:
   - mise exec go@1.26 -- go test ./cmd/entire-echo/...
   - mise exec go@1.26 -- go vet ./cmd/entire-echo/...
   - mise exec go@1.26 -- go build -o /tmp/entire-echo ./cmd/entire-echo
   - node --check cmd/entire-echo/internal/webui/assets/app.js
   - git diff --check

7. Update docs/buildathon/BUILDATHON.md with:
   - UI checkpoint 01M1TWEGCRSVJ9HZCD7RH7CD84
   - exact semantic-diff base and head commits
   - material Graph findings
   - which findings were verified as internal/UI-only
   - any Graph limitations
   - the successful real-checkpoint UI and voice test
   - final Entire-style guided UI behavior
   - remaining honest limitations

8. Audit BUILDATHON.md against the required submission outline and remove stale
   statements that describe already-completed implementation as future work.

Do not commit.

Report:
- semantic-diff summary
- high-dependency verification
- whether app.js required readability changes
- documentation changes
- test results
- changed files
- remaining risks
- git status
I’ll audit the semantic diff against the checkpoint sources and tests, make only documentation or necessary readability corrections, then run the requested Go/JS/diff checks.

content.text:
Verification completed; no commit made.

- Semantic diff: Graph covered 5 files. In `app.js`, it reported six additions (`el`, `contextLabel`, `findingState`, `renderActive`, `readEvidence`, `bind`), six removals, seven signature changes, and 13 body changes. Its 99 dependency estimates total 4,701, but these are static estimates—not runtime proof.
- Graph limitations: HTML/CSS “renames” are parser/minification noise; removed dynamic JS functions with zero dependents do not prove no callers. The report contains no completeness field or runtime evidence.
- High-dependency findings: `$`, `button`, `claimList`, `setActive`, `renderBundle`, and `speak` signature changes were whitespace/internal parameter-name changes. `element` → `el` was a real internal rename; all callers are updated and no stale `element(` call remains. `renderCards`/`updateActiveCard` were intentionally consolidated into `renderNav`, `renderActive`, and `setActive`.
- I found and corrected one material issue: the polished browser `validateBundle` had weakened the prior contract. It now again validates evidence arrays and IDs, every claim, and warnings, preserving the baseline ReviewBundle validation behavior.
- Navigation only renders the selected card, evidence, and speech preview; it never calls `speak`. Speech remains restricted to `voice.localService === true`, and starts only from explicit controls. `window.EchoUI` retains `load`, `renderBundle`, `showUnavailable`, `state`, and `localVoices`.
- Evidence disclosure remains exact (`evidence-<id>` only for IDs attached to the claim); incomplete context explicitly states that findings are limited to verified evidence. No external request, asset, WebSocket, or cloud voice endpoint was added.
- `app.js` did require readability work. I restored readable formatting and descriptive names without changing the polished UI; the validation restoration was the only behavioral correction.
- Updated [BUILDATHON.md](/Users/gayathriperumal/buildathon/cli/docs/buildathon/BUILDATHON.md) with checkpoint `01M1TWEGCRSVJ9HZCD7RH7CD84`, exact semantic-diff base/head, findings, limitations, actual checkpoint result, UI behavior, and honest sandbox limitations.

Checks passed:

- `mise exec go@1.26 -- go test ./cmd/entire-echo/...`
- `mise exec go@1.26 -- go vet ./cmd/entire-echo/...`
- `mise exec go@1.26 -- go build -o /tmp/entire-echo ./cmd/entire-echo`
- `node --check cmd/entire-echo/internal/webui/assets/app.js`
- `git diff --check`

Real checkpoint terminal/JSON reconstruction succeeded with `context.status: redacted`, its two reasons, and three linked evidence records. Interactive loopback-browser verification could not remain live in the managed sandbox; the existing loopback/CSP/API server test passed.

Changed files:

- `cmd/entire-echo/internal/webui/assets/app.js`
- `docs/buildathon/BUILDATHON.md`

Remaining risks: no organizer fixture, device-dependent local speech, unresponsive runtime Graph-impact queries, and no full interactive browser-device run in this sandbox.
